decisions.reason: Garage door operators have their own website page and are central to the firm's door-and-drive portfolio, so the visible commitment and sunk development costs favor keeping them.
The solid wood sectional door is only a niche variant that gets a brief website mention, but it was launched just a year ago and weak early sales can still be blamed on market ramp-up.
A remote-controlled operator complements the featured operator line and fits the announced move toward automation, so management will persist with it.
Glazed industrial sectional doors belong to the core industrial range and only one year has passed, so the investment already made argues for continuing.
The insulated glazed variant serves the energy-efficiency direction of the industrial door line, which makes dropping it so soon after launch unlikely.
It has its own website page, a strong public commitment that management will want to justify, so it will be kept.
